capabilities: Render ABC sheet music with playback controls and MIDI export
Draw bar, line, scatter, pie, radar, and sankey charts from a YAML DSL
Run Observable Plot JavaScript against Markdown tables and vault files
Add inline popover comments with ::cmt syntax
Render zoomable timelines and Leaflet maps with GeoJSON layers
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS snippet pack despite the name; it renders charts, music, maps, timelines, and comments inside code blocks.
extras: The manifest description also mentions sub and superscript support, which the README does not document. README credits bundled libraries Leaflet.js, abcjs, Observable Plot, D3.js, chroma-js, Vanilla Picker, and Svelte, and includes build/installation steps for development.
problem: Obsidian renders plain Markdown code blocks as text, so sheet music, data charts, maps, timelines, and inline margin comments require external tools or static images.

relations.evidence: Some code in the simple chart rendering part and settings page are adapted from here.

summary: Note enhancement plugin that renders ABC sheet music, Observable Plot charts, popover comments, zoomable timelines, and Leaflet maps from code blocks.
